Our website and online order forms have been updated!

Roswell Family Farm offers pasture-raised chicken and pork by the cut, so you can order exactly what your family wants without purchasing a whole animal.

👉 Swipe through the graphics to see our current cuts, prices and availability.

🌐 HOW TO ORDER

Visit RoswellFamilyFarm.com, select Chicken Orders or Pork Cuts Orders, and enter the quantities you want. Enter 0 for anything you don’t want.

We’ll review your request, confirm availability and calculate your total using the actual packaged weights. Pickup, meet-up or delivery arrangements will be confirmed directly.

⚠️ PLEASE NOTIFY US AFTER ORDERING
